title: GPU hung on one of our command buffers (VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST)
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible in 4.5 stable

### System information

Vulkan 1.3.255 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Intel - Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2)

### Issue description

From what I can guess based on the "importing" progress bar, it fails when trying to import a new .exr (menu.exr) on my linux computer that was created on a windows computer. I was able to open the project last week with its existing lightmap (tutorial.exr)

### Steps to reproduce

1. open the project
